label: Men · Wraps
rows: Carlos Antonio Gómez de los Santos

metrics.label: Our rating
metrics.tip: The DOTS we expect at the lifter's next meet (our forecast, as of today).

metrics.label: Best DOTS
metrics.tip: The best DOTS score in the window: total adjusted for bodyweight (Konertz 2019).

metrics.label: Best IPF GL
metrics.tip: The best IPF GL (Goodlift) points in the window, the IPF's own bodyweight formula.

metrics.label: Best Wilks
metrics.tip: The best Wilks score in the window (the older bodyweight formula, still used by some federations).

metrics.label: Best total
metrics.tip: The heaviest full-power total in the window.

metrics.label: Best squat
metrics.tip: The heaviest squat in a full-power meet in the window.

metrics.label: Best bench
metrics.tip: The heaviest bench press in a full-power meet in the window.

metrics.label: Best deadlift
metrics.tip: The heaviest deadlift in a full-power meet in the window.

metrics.label: Total per kg of bodyweight
metrics.tip: Best total divided by bodyweight on the day.

metrics.label: Squat per kg of bodyweight
metrics.tip: Squat at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight.

metrics.label: Bench per kg of bodyweight
metrics.tip: Bench at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight.

metrics.label: Deadlift per kg of bodyweight
metrics.tip: Deadlift at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight.

metrics.label: Squat share of total
metrics.tip: The squat as a share of the best total: a style, not better or worse.

metrics.label: Bench share of total
metrics.tip: The bench as a share of the best total: a style.

metrics.label: Deadlift share of total
metrics.tip: The deadlift as a share of the best total: a style.

metrics.label: Attempts made
metrics.tip: Share of attempts made, all three lifts, shrunk toward the stream average (as if nine more attempts at the average).

metrics.label: Squats made
metrics.tip: Share of squat attempts made (shrunk).

metrics.label: Benches made
metrics.tip: Share of bench attempts made (shrunk).

metrics.label: Deadlifts made
metrics.tip: Share of deadlift attempts made (shrunk).

metrics.label: Third attempts made
metrics.tip: Share of third attempts made (shrunk toward the average with six attempts).

metrics.label: Third-attempt jump
metrics.tip: The average jump from a made second attempt to the third, as a share of the second: bold or careful, a style.

metrics.label: Beat our forecast
metrics.tip: Share of meets above our pre-meet expectation (shrunk toward half with four meets).

metrics.label: Meet value
metrics.tip: Average DOTS above our pre-meet expectation per meet (shrunk toward zero with three meets).

metrics.label: Meet-to-meet spread
metrics.tip: How far each meet lands from the lifter's own trend line, in DOTS (shrunk). Lower is steadier.

metrics.label: Bomb-out rate
metrics.tip: Share of full-power meets without a total (shrunk toward the stream rate with five meets).

metrics.label: Progress per year
metrics.tip: The trend in DOTS per year over the window (shrunk toward zero for a short span).

metrics.label: Meets
metrics.tip: Scored full-power meets in the window.
